items.requirement: Trip-cost calculator: entries x buy-ins + nights x true hotel cost
items.note: Computed from published components; dated Venetian quote (23-30 Nov 2026, $4,010.55 all-in) shown beside the $197.28 published-components floor.

items.requirement: Scheduled automatic re-check of every official URL; mark rows whose source changed
items.note: Single scheduled job (12:10 UTC + push trigger) fetches each official URL, stores a content hash of the visible text, flags genuine changes; unavailable URLs are never reported as changed. Latest recorded run monitored 108 official URLs (85 fetched, 2 visible-text changes).

items.requirement: Read every structure sheet; remove 'unverified' only where confirmed
items.note: All 52 official sheets read (37 DSE IV + 15 NYE). No sheet prints a one-entry-per-player cap, so no row is labelled 'single entry confirmed'; sheet-screened candidates show the printed excerpt, source and retrieval date.

items.requirement: 'Last checked' date on every row
items.note: Every tournament, hotel, walking-route and source record carries a retrieval date, and the distribution is derived from site/data.json at build time so it cannot go stale: 49 of 341 event rows last checked 2026-11-17, 292 of 341 event rows last checked 2026-11-19.

items.requirement: Hotel rates kept as a dated log, not a single value
items.note: Append-only rate log; each observation carries observedOn, source, fee, tax, quote type. Dated Venetian checkout quote 23-30 Nov 2026 ($4,010.55) logged; calendar cells explicitly not treated as prices (F47/F69).

items.requirement: One page per venue (Venetian, Wynn, others), each with its events and hotels
items.note: Seven Strip poker rooms; each venue page lists its dated events and its hotels with official source links.

items.requirement: Search box across all tables
items.location: site/search.html + top search form on every page
items.note: Global search across tournaments, hotel rows, dated rates, walking routes, sources, questions and review flags; tournament table keeps its own local filters.

items.requirement: Shared COORDINATION.md task board before parallel sessions
items.note: Single shared board listing each task, status, owning session, scope and files; integration-owner convention for shared outputs.

items.requirement: Capture checkout total, nightly average, mandatory resort fee, tax, parking, cancellation deadline, rate timestamp; compare like-for-like
items.note: Venetian dated checkout total $4,010.55 (23-30 Nov 2026) with per-night rates, $55 fee, 13.38% tax, $20/$25/$40 parking, 11 a.m. checkout, $100 early checkout, $150 incidental. The Venetian and Palazzo rows carry the venue's printed poker-room parking waiver (three or more hours of play = complimentary self-parking for the day, supervisor-confirmed), not netted off any total (F86). Official parking dollar rates are now published for all eight hotels (including MGM's $20/day guest self-parking on mgmresorts.com and Caesars Palace $20/day guest / Horseshoe $20 Mon-Wed, $25 Thu-Sun on caesars.com/parking, F99/F102). On 2026-11-19 the Wynn engine printed a dated trip-window quote ($495/$405 avg/night including the resort fee, taxes excluded), while room-tax % remains unprinted on the six non-Venetian/Palazzo property pages and the Venetian engine rendered loading text only (F93).

items.requirement: Flag overlapping entries using start time, late-registration cutoff, plausible duration; primary event + conditional fallback per day
items.note: One primary sheet-screened candidate per day with a conditional fallback and reason; overlap flags under a disclosed six-hour session estimate. No venue publishes finish times (F16).

items.requirement: Guarantee / entry fee shown as descriptive ratio, never a forecast; bounty/flight labelled separately
items.note: ratio = guarantee / buy-in recomputed for every numeric row; category labels separate multi-flight, satellite, bounty/PKO and extra-spend rows.

items.requirement: Date selector showing only events on chosen days
items.note: From/To date selectors plus venue, category, format, single-entry and 30-minute-walk filters.

items.requirement: Structured rule fields per event: single-entry, re-entry, add-on, fee, each with source excerpt and retrieval date
items.note: singleEntry / reEntry / addOn / fee blocks each carry status, excerpt, source link and retrieved date; blanks explained by note or flag.

items.requirement: Walking-route check: official-address walking times per hotel-venue pair, 30-minute limit applied
items.note: 56 of 56 hotel-venue pairs recorded as Google Maps walking estimates; 7 rows are dated 2026-11-16 and 49 rows are dated 2026-11-17; every row carries its own measurement date. No venue publishes a walking time, so F32 and F67 keep the point-in-time and endpoint caveats. The tournaments table's 30-minute limit is opt-in and measured from a hotel the reader selects; rows over the limit and rows with no measured route are counted separately, so a missing estimate is never shown as an eliminated option.

items.requirement: Re-check official pages on a schedule and flag any value that changed
items.note: Same automated re-check as C2; changed hash = review signal only, never an automatic value change.

items.requirement: Find live upcoming Strip poker tournaments; rank by cost to enter and prize pool
items.note: 341 rows with buy-in, guarantee and guarantee/entry-fee ratio; single-entry filters surface the cheapest credible entries.

items.requirement: Single-entry tournaments only; multi-entry / rebuy / add-on kept in a separate section
items.note: Sheet-screened candidate list vs separate extra-spend bucket (re-entry/rebuys/add-ons/paid chip boosts/multi-flight) with the exact clause quoted per row. Strict confirmed-entry filter returns 0 because no sheet prints a per-player maximum.

items.requirement: Best hotels within walking distance; true cost per night incl. resort fee; cost/quality priority over distance, distance reasonable (<=30 min walk)
items.note: True cost/night = (rate + resort fee) x 1.1338 where published; walking estimates with 30-min filter; quality column blank because no official quality score exists (F19). Dated quotes: Venetian 23-30 Nov 2026 (checkout total) and Wynn 23-30 Nov 2026 (avg/night incl. fee, taxes excluded, read 2026-11-19); other properties' engines returned no attributable grid on 2026-11-19.

items.requirement: Tournament schedule playable all day from 8 AM; enter as many live tournaments as possible
items.note: No official Strip room publishes an 8:00 AM start. The earliest recurring official start is 9:00 AM at Horseshoe; the Venetian's earliest dated row is a 9:10 AM satellite (seats not cash), and main-list starts begin at 10:00-10:10 AM. The all-day plan is built from the earliest verified starts instead; the 8 AM gap remains flagged.

items.note: 104 flags, each with its official source link; verify_site.py enforces official-domain source links and intentional blanks for unverified values.
